$comment: Format registry v2 — definitions re-verified 2026-08-21 against live sources. Records carry `_verified` explaining what was checked and what changed; `_source` on each example is provenance and is stripped before the writer sees it. Formats without examples are unconfirmed, not merely unseeded.

x.notes: Caption describes the clip in keyword salad for discovery. The clip is the joke. Alt structure: quote line -> 'Me:' -> reaction clip.

reddit.notes: Title is deliberately flat. Top posts today used titles like 'Sunday morning', 'To be continued', 'Idk what to put here'. Put ZERO joke in the title. Topic must be a communal grievance: cost of living, rent, job market, gym, dating.

formats.name: Saxophone gets louder

slot_guidance.setup: The mundane moment of impending doom, stated plainly. The catchphrase 'and the saxophones get louder' is the fixed tag that ends it.
slot_guidance.the_detail: The small fact that makes it inevitable. Never state the consequence.

examples.setup: When you forgot to send that one email
examples._source: canonical example quoted in yahoo.com/dictionary.com trend explainers

formats.origin: Boyz n the Hood (1991) score; revived by @foreverhumblemarc96, Dec 2025
formats._verified: 2026-08-21: origin and meaning corrected — it signals impending doom, it is not a slow-realisation reveal.
formats._register_conflict: The canonical real example opens with 'When you', which the tiktok register bans outright.

formats.name: Supportive / disappointed / sarcastic / flirty

slot_guidance.one_line: ONE sentence, reused verbatim across all four beats. It must be a line that plausibly changes meaning with delivery. Only the tone changes.

formats.automation_note: Easiest format to fully automate: one text generation, four TTS calls with tone control, no editing decisions.

examples.one_line: I didn't order the tuna salad
You can have the last bite

formats._verified: 2026-08-21: fourth tone corrected from 'flirty' to 'angry'. Real set is supportive/sarcastic/disappointed/angry.

formats.name: Netflix documentary

slot_guidance.caption: ONE line. A tease for a confession you never actually make — the video ends before the story does. Real posts are short, casual, and often use emoji and capitals; they are not deadpan chyrons.

examples.caption: I've waited for as long as possible for this moment to tell my truth 😬
The eldest daughter lore is UNMATCHED!!
let me know what you want me to start with

formats.staging: Sit in a chair, talking-head style, eyes just off camera as if answering a producer. Mini mic optional. The performance carries it.
formats._verified: 2026-08-21: rewritten. Registry had lower_third/ominous_claim/evidence_label/witness_line; no real post uses that structure. Real format is one caption plus performance.
formats._register_conflict: Real captions use capitals and emoji, both banned by the tiktok register.

formats.name: Reasons to get a bob

audio.note: Trend rests on mishearing 'get that bag' as 'get that bob'.

slot_guidance.reason_*: DO NOT ESCALATE. Every reason is the same thing, stated identically — the original is literally '1. Bob 2. Bob 3. Bob 4. Bob'. The joke is a list that refuses to vary; escalation kills it. Variation lives in the camera angle and delivery, never the text.

examples._source: Jocelyn Meiere, TikTok — 80M+ views, via thetab.com/2026/07/02
Attack on Titan variant, TikTok — each 'reason' is a character with a bob

formats.origin: Jocelyn Meiere, TikTok; first video 80M+ views
formats.fit_note: Tied to the bob haircut itself. Adapting it to an unrelated product is a stretch — the repeated noun has to be something visible.
formats._verified: 2026-08-21: mechanic corrected — was documented as mandatory escalation, which is the opposite of the real format.

formats.name: How different our lives are

audio.track: You Make My Dreams — Hall & Oates

slot_guidance.timestamp: A specific clock time. Never 'morning' or 'later'.
slot_guidance.life_b: Same structure, opposite content. The parallel IS the joke.

formats._verified: 2026-08-21: format exists (two contrasting routines cut together, one calm one chaotic), but the Hall & Oates track and the 'timestamp' slot could NOT be confirmed. Needs real posts.

formats.name: Me at the same age as my parents

slot_guidance.parent_milestone: Something concrete and quantified: a house, two kids, a mortgage figure.
slot_guidance.your_reality: Concrete and small. Never self-pitying — flat delivery only.

formats.name: X reaction clip (keyword-salad caption)

slot_guidance.search_caption: Describe the clip exhaustively in lowercase keyword salad — subject, action, emotion, and every synonym someone might search. This is discovery text, NOT a joke. Observed at 1M and 1.2M views.

slot_guidance.quoted_expectation: A social expectation stated in quotes, the more clichéd the better. The clip supplies the rebuttal.

examples.search_caption: robert pattinson chris hansen primetime you see how this looks right /// reaction meme
you see how this looks, right?

formats._verified: 2026-08-21: keyword-salad caption model confirmed by real posts.

formats.name: Reddit grievance image macro

slot_guidance.title: DELIBERATELY FLAT. A label, not a joke. Observed top posts today: 'Sunday morning', 'To be continued', 'Idk what to put here'. If the title is funny, the post underperforms.
slot_guidance.image_text: Carries the entire joke. Topic must be a shared grievance — graduate job market, inflation, rent, gym, dating. Today's #1 (38.2K) was graduate unemployment; #2 (12.4K) was inflation.

formats._verified: 2026-08-21: not sourceable — reddit.com is unreachable from this environment. Needs real posts.
